parse.name: same reference twice is linked twice
a reference equal to self is not a reference
no self id at the start
punctuation around a reference is fine
seven characters, uppercase, glued words are not ids
self needs a space, newline or end after it
self at the very end of a short body
label longer than 40 characters is not a sender prefix
self after a newline is not self
